parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records — `ProcessInfo.ThermalState.description` in `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift` — carries `is_sample_app: true`, which is a restraint marker that dominates any action signal. Lifting the shared thermal-state description logic into the production `Wallpaper` package (or vice versa) would couple production code to sample-app semantics. The near-duplicate signal (Jaccard 0.75) is real but insufficient to override the restraint: the sample-app copy in `DebugHUD.swift` is a deliberate, self-contained debug convenience, not a leftover prototype that should be deleted.
